summary: Enhance your skills with our Facility and Building Maintenance Management Training Course. Learn best practices and boost your career in facility management.
lede: Building maintenance management links asset information, maintenance planning, work orders and performance reporting to support reliable building operations. For facilities managers, maintenance leads and building-services professionals, the course focuses on organizing preventive and corrective work across assets, technicians and contractors. Learners practice building asset registers, ranking equipment risks, preparing preventive job plans, structuring CMMS workflows and tracking maintenance KPIs through performance dashboards.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals responsible for maintaining buildings, coordinating technical services, governing facilities contracts, and reporting asset performance. It suits intermediate to advanced learners who already work with maintenance requests, inspections, service providers, or building asset decisions.
prerequisites: You should have practical exposure to building operations, maintenance requests, inspections, contractors, or facilities coordination. No programming is required. You should be comfortable reading basic maintenance records, work orders, equipment schedules, and operating budgets. Advanced topics such as AI-assisted predictive maintenance, BIM information, and Power BI dashboards are taught at conceptual and operational application levels, not at technical engineering or production deployment level.
